title: The Kubernetes etcd must have file permissions set to 644 or more restrictive.
check_content:
Review the permissions of the Kubernetes etcd by using the command:

ls -AR /var/lib/etcd/*

If any of the files have permissions more permissive than "644", this is a finding.
fixtext:
Change the permissions of the manifest files to "644" by executing the command:

chmod -R 644 /var/lib/etcd/*
VulnDiscussion: The Kubernetes etcd key-value store provides a way to store data to the Control Plane. If these files can be changed, data to API object and Control Plane would be compromised.
